title: Everyday Actions and Routines
summary: Use common action words in simple subject-plus-action sentences and talk about routines.

sketchBlocks.title: manje, bwè, travay, etidye, ale
sketchBlocks.bodyMarkdown:
Start with a few useful action words:

- **manje** — eat
- **bwè** — drink
- **travay** — work
- **etidye** — study
- **ale** — go

These are reusable building blocks for everyday sentences.

sketchBlocks.title: Subject + action
sketchBlocks.bodyMarkdown:
For a simple present statement, put the subject before the action:

- **Mwen manje.** — I eat.
- **Ou travay.** — You work.
- **Li etidye.** — He/she studies.

The action word itself does not change for each person.

sketchBlocks.title: chak jou
sketchBlocks.bodyMarkdown:
**chak jou** means “every day.”

With routine language, the basic subject + action pattern still works:

- **Jan travay chak jou.** — Jan works every day.
- **Mari etidye chak jou.** — Mari studies every day.

The time expression tells you that this is a routine.
